_source: Extracted + genericized from the reference design's About page botanical/product lifecycle section (some_styles/canehouse/priority) - a full-circle growth-to-product-to-soil journey, distinct from process-steps.json (the 6-step production/preparation process). Each step carries its own media gallery (images/videos) plus a longer 'details' paragraph, in addition to the short summary 'text', so a component can show a compact list view or an expanded/gallery view from the same data.
title: From Seed To Soil
cycle_note: The cycle doesn't end at delivery - what's left behind returns to the soil, ready to nurture the next planting.

steps.title: Planting
steps.text: Seeds are planted in nutrient-rich soil.
steps.details: Healthy stalks are selected and cut into short sections, each holding a few buds. These are laid into prepared furrows of rich, well-drained soil, ready to take root with the first watering.

steps.title: Growth
steps.text: Months of sun and care nurture healthy growth.
steps.details: Over several months, tall green stalks rise under steady sun and regular watering. Careful weeding and natural pest control keep each field healthy through the growing season.

steps.title: Maturity
steps.text: The crop reaches its peak ripeness.
steps.details: As the stalks reach full height, natural sugars build up inside. Color and firmness are checked closely to judge exactly when the crop has reached its sweetest, most flavourful point.

steps.title: Harvesting
steps.text: Handpicked at just the right time.
steps.details: Stalks are cut close to the ground by hand, preserving as much of the natural goodness inside as possible, then bundled and moved quickly to avoid any loss of freshness.

steps.title: Processing
steps.text: Cleaned and prepared with traditional methods.
steps.details: Harvested stalks are washed, trimmed and cut into workable lengths. Traditional preparation methods are used throughout, keeping the process close to how it has always been done.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.details: Prepared stalks are pressed to draw out their natural juice, then strained to remove fiber and impurities, leaving behind a pure, fresh result ready for the final step.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.details: The final result is chilled and delivered without delay, so what reaches you is as close as possible to the moment it was first pressed.

steps.title: Enjoyed
steps.text: Savoured fresh by the people who matter most.
steps.details: From a quiet moment at home to a shared celebration, this is where the journey pays off - enjoyed fresh, exactly as intended.

steps.title: Leftover Fiber
steps.details: The fiber left behind after pressing is collected rather than discarded, kept aside for its next natural purpose.

steps.title: Decomposition
steps.details: Left to break down naturally, the leftover fiber slowly returns to organic matter - the same quiet process that has always closed the loop.

steps.title: Fertilizer
steps.text: Returned to the soil as natural fertilizer.
steps.details: What decomposes becomes rich, natural fertilizer, restoring the same soil the next planting will grow from - completing the full cycle.
